The '''Port of Lafete''' was a [[city]] on [[Lafete]] that contained a [[Lafete diner|diner]].<ref name="Art of Mando 2" /> [[Boba Fett]] and [[Din Djarin]] traveled to the Port of Lafete to meet with [[Bo-Katan Kryze]] and [[Koska Reeves]].<ref name="Chapter 16">{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 16: The Rescue}}</ref>

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Port of Lafete debuted in "[[Chapter 16: The Rescue]]" from the [[The Mandalorian Season Two|second season]] of ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''. [[Amy Beth Christenson]] from [[Lucasfilm Animation]] was briefly brought in to ''The Mandalorian'' design team, and the bulk of her work consisted the interior of [[Gideon's light cruiser]], as well as the backdrop for the Port of Lafete and [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace]].<ref name="Art of Mando 2" />
